supersede.name: Lakera
supersede.description: Check Point AI-security platform for workforce AI governance, AI application guardrails, agent discovery, risk assessment, runtime protection and red teaming.
supersede.useCase: For enterprises that need unified discovery, governance and runtime protection across employee AI use, generative-AI applications and autonomous agents.
supersede.reason: Check Point acquired Lakera and the current product documentation and commercial offering are now branded as Check Point AI Security, including AI Agent Security and AI Guardrails. Keeping Lakera as a separate current platform would preserve an outdated standalone identity.
supersede.userValue: Check Point AI Security is the current platform carrying Lakera's runtime guardrail technology forward into a broader enterprise AI-security offering.
